nodes.description: CLI process operator: parses arguments, loads and validates configuration, builds the app, and hands it to the single worker HTTP server. Starts the lifecycle and receives its return.
Single-process ASGI HTTP server and event loop bound to settings.host:settings.port. Drives ASGI lifespan startup before serving and shutdown on termination.
JSONC configuration adapter: resolves {"env": ...} references and produces validated domain Settings (models, pairs, timeouts, compression workers).

Composition root. Creates the JSON event sink and returns a FastAPI app whose lifespan constructs the httpx client, Headroom compressor, Switchyard router, HTTPX transport, and Gateway. Allocates no adapter resource itself.

Application core orchestrating routing, compression, and forwarding through injected ports. Constructed by the lifespan and installed on app.state so ingress resolves it per request. Process-local _positions and _cooldowns begin empty each start.
Pooled async HTTP client constructed inside the lifespan and registered on its AsyncExitStack. Released by client.aclose() on teardown.

Headroom structural compression adapter constructed inside the lifespan and registered on its AsyncExitStack. Owns one execution thread plus a worker-count semaphore that bounds running and queued submissions.
Single worker thread running synchronous Headroom compression off the event loop. Joined by executor.shutdown(wait=True, cancel_futures=True) during close.
JSON-lines event sink shared by the app and Gateway; serializes gateway-owned records and never raw payloads or dependency exceptions.
Process stdout stream receiving the startup and shutdown records. The sink of both lifecycle-event branches.
Switchyard stage-routing adapter constructed with the stage policy. Construction only stores the policy; no SDK call happens at boot.
Backend transport adapter wrapping the injected pooled client; no connection is opened at construction.
Ingress factory. Builds the FastAPI application, records the supplied lifespan context manager, and registers routes that resolve the Gateway from app.state.
ASGI application returned to uvicorn. On lifespan startup it enters build_app's lifespan context manager; on shutdown it resumes it.

Async context manager owning the app lifetime: constructs the adapters on an AsyncExitStack, emits one startup record, yields while serving, then releases each step independently and emits exactly one shutdown record.

The startup emit raises (broken stdout) inside the guarded try: the AsyncExitStack still releases the compressor and client, and the shutdown record is still emitted before the exception propagates (bootstrap.py:39-68).
client.aclose() raises: release records the failure, the compressor was already released, and the shutdown record carries error='shutdown_failed' (bootstrap.py:32-37, 46, 64-68).
compressor.close() raises: release records the failure, client.aclose() still runs, and the shutdown record carries error='shutdown_failed' (bootstrap.py:32-37, 48, 64-68).
Lifespan-owned construction: a bind or start failure before the lifespan is entered leaves no client or executor allocated, so there is nothing to leak (bootstrap.py:26-70).
